wa_mount_adams_north_ridge.trailhead_note: Same Killen Creek trailhead as sources (WTA coords 46.2885, -121.5525). No published trailhead-to-summit mileage found. No sign our pin is a different trailhead. Peakbagger ascents list (pid 2365) showed only a South-side North Cleaver log in the latest year.

other_facts.fact: Killen Creek trail meets the PCT just after 3 miles; continue straight toward High Camp
Killen Creek trailhead is 5.7 mi down FR 2329 from FR 23; ~3 mi from Takhlakh Lake; trailhead elev 4,584 ft
Camp to summit 7-9 hr; summit to trailhead 5-8 hr; trailhead to camp 3-4 hr (Adams Glacier profile)
Descent is the North Ridge on loose scree and boulders; rockfall risk

wa_castle_in_the_sky.trailhead_note: Mountain Project lists access from Hannegan Pass (FS Road 32 off SR 542) to Whatcom Pass, or from Little Beaver via Ross Dam trailhead (Hwy 20). Hannegan trailhead is a valid start; Little Beaver/Ross Lake is the other. Hannegan Pass trailhead at road end, 3,120 ft (Mountaineers). No Hannegan-to-base distance found.

other_facts.fact: Castle in the Sky climbs the left edge of Whatcom Peak south buttress; P1 5.7 150 ft, P2 5.8 190 ft, P3 5.9R 200 ft, P4 5.10b 120 ft
South side route reached from Whatcom Pass by low orbit east of peak, or from Easy Ridge to Perfect Pass; North Ridge from Whatcom Pass heading south
Hannegan Pass trail drops to the Chilliwack River then up to Whatcom Pass
